protocol: NeuroVision AI - Phase 7 Stage C Patient-Level Calibration Split
selection_method: Volume-stratified rank interleaving using ground-truth tumor volumes

split_transparency_and_provenance_declar.methodological_provenance: The 5-patient locked-test cohort was NOT generated through random sampling. It was partitioned deterministically using ground-truth tumor volume characteristics across all 10 validation patients to ensure structural stratification across tumor burdens.
split_transparency_and_provenance_declar.ground_truth_knowledge_disclosure: Ground-truth Whole Tumor volumes of all 10 validation patients were used to establish the rank-interleaved ordering prior to experiment design.
locked_test_independence_guarantee: No locked-test model predictions or inference outputs were inspected or generated to select the split.
No model outputs from locked-test patients will be used for candidate threshold selection.
The calibration and locked-test groups are strictly mutually exclusive (0 patient overlap).
The partition is permanently sealed and will NOT be modified after threshold calibration begins or after observing test outcomes.

calibration_cohort.description: Used exclusively for threshold grid search and objective optimization. Never used for final certification.

locked_test_cohort.description: Completely locked and untouched during candidate threshold selection. Evaluated strictly once for final independent certification.

volume_imbalance_documentation.analysis_and_limitation: The Locked Test cohort has systematically higher mean tumor burden than the Calibration cohort (+22.5% for WT, +53.6% for TC, and +79.5% for ET). Rank interleaving preserved rank ordering, but the extremes (smallest tumor in Calib, largest in Test) create a non-negligible volume shift. This imbalance must be treated as a source of variance between calibration and test results, reinforcing that results cannot be generalized beyond this sample.
